prerequisites: Observed engagement with the right drawer handle.
progress_signals: Right drawer front moves outward relative to the cabinet.
failure_signals: Repeated pulling produces no drawer displacement.
Gripper slips off the handle while the drawer remains closed.

evidence.fact: Robot starts away from the right drawer handle; drawer appears closed.

Fingerpad center separation increased from approximately 0.048 m to 0.086 m and wrist descended approximately 0.007 m. Gripper remains away from the drawer handle; no attempted pull or visible contact obstruction is established.

hypotheses: Small motion and gripper opening may be initial preparation; sustained approach progress is not yet established.

evidence.fact: Wrist remained near the initial pose above drawer height, with open fingers.

Wrist is now at measured position [-0.0053,-0.3055,0.3143] in osc_arm_base, substantially displaced and rotated from step 40. Right and wrist views show the open gripper approaching the cabinet at drawer height; the handle remains visible and grasp is not established.

hypotheses: VLA is still approaching and aligning before handle engagement.

evidence.fact: Open gripper was approaching the cabinet with the target handle visible at a distance in the wrist view.

Right camera shows open fingers near the right drawer handle, and the wrist camera shows a close handle view. Wrist changed by approximately [0.252,-0.159,-0.220] m since step 207. Fingerpad separation remains approximately 0.086 m; grasp and drawer displacement are not established.

hypotheses: The gripper is completing close alignment before engagement.

evidence.fact: Prior review observed open fingers close to the right drawer handle, with engagement unconfirmed.
Measured wrist position was [0.2898,-0.5571,-0.0516] m with fingers open; subsequent commands repeatedly made small translational corrections without closure.

Right image shows open fingers below the horizontal drawer handle at the lower cabinet panel; wrist image shows panel rather than the handle. Wrist remains near the step-491 position (about 26 mm net change). Current selected handle-region geometry is about 120 mm above the control site and 176 mm away overall; region contains visible surfaces, not an exact grasp point.

hypotheses: Approach has descended below the intended handle and small corrections are not restoring alignment. Contact or the cause of this mismatch is unproven; fresh paused-state assessment should determine whether bounded recovery is needed.
Flora's whole-attempt phase score of 4 may reflect earlier approach; its grasp-alignment hypothesis does not agree with the current right-camera view and measured handle-region separation.
